description: A cheaper opt-in version of Upstage's Solar Pro 4, the same long-context model for agentic workflows, office productivity, document-intensive work and coding, with reasoning disabled for faster direct responses. Prompts and outputs sent to this Contributor model may be used by Upstage to improve its models; use the standard Solar Pro 4 if you do not want your data used for training.
name: Solar Pro 4 Contributor
